0.2.n: This is the general counting word for two items.

0.4.n: The small っ marks a brief pause before the final sound in this general counting word.

0.8.n: This is the beginning of いつつ, the general counting word for five items; it is not separate here.

1.0.n: This is the general counting word for six items, with a small っ marking a brief pause.

1.2.n: This begins ななつ, the general counting word for seven items; it is not a separate word here.

1.5.n: This is the general counting word for eight items, with a small っ marking a brief pause.

1.7.n: This begins ここのつ, the general counting word for nine items; it does not mean here in this line.

1.8.n: This is inside ここのつ, the general counting word for nine items; it is not a linking particle here.

1.9.n: This ends ここのつ, the general counting word for nine items; it is not a separate word here.

0.tip: These are general counting words for items; いつつ is one word despite the subtitle splitting.

1.tip: ななつ and ここのつ are each single counting words, despite being split into smaller pieces here.
